verdict.rationale: Loops documents programmatic access to much of the email program. The API covers contacts, campaigns, content, themes and workflows. Workflow graphs can be created and updated from code, and the official MCP server lets an agent read and write contacts, mailing lists, events and content. However, nothing shows that campaign performance results (opens, clicks, conversions) can be retrieved by API or MCP. The revenue and upgrade attribution claim describes the dashboard, so an agent cannot evidently report on what's working. Missing for 10: API/MCP access to campaign or email performance metrics, explicit read/list endpoints for live automations and their status, documented bulk audience export, hands-on corroboration.
